dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hey, have you heard what our superiors have been saying? Inazuma, long under the Sakoku Decree, has become an open country again!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: What? Did they seriously abolish it?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: First the Vision Hunt Decree, and now the Sakoku Decree... These were both the direct decrees of the Electro Archon. Is she preparing to do something big soon?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Oh no. If the Electro Archon plans to involve herself in external affairs again, won't this affect our influence over Teyvat?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, you're being such a worrywart.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: With Her Majesty the Tsaritsa on our side, Snezhnaya's eternal greatness is assured! There's absolutely no reason for us to worry!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: In fact, I'd say that Inazuma opening up is instead a great opportunity for us Fatui to expand our strength there.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Indeed, everything that's happening is well within our control!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Well, I sure hope you're right...
